tagline: Organize, share, pin, and manage Odoo filters with folders, favorites, recent history, and team sharing
problem: Odoo favorites have no folders, weak sharing, no recent history, and poor discoverability when teams collect dozens of filters.
solution: Filter Manager turns favorites into a navigation hub with Outlook-style folders, pinning, color tags, usage analytics, JSON import/export, and duplicate detection.
benefits: Folder organization for Sales, CRM, Invoices, and custom models
Pin critical filters like Today's Sales or Overdue Invoices
Recent history with automatic cleanup limits
Private, shared, team, company, and global visibility
Export and import JSON when migrating databases

features.title: Folder sidebar
features.text: Group filters into Sales, Invoices, CRM, Warehouse, and nested folders.

features.title: Pin and favorite
features.text: Keep high-value filters on top with pins and star favorites.

features.title: Recent filters
features.text: Automatic recent history with configurable retention.

features.title: Sharing scopes
features.text: Private, shared, team, company, and global filter types.

features.title: Usage analytics
features.text: See how many times a filter was used and when it was last opened.

features.title: Import and export
features.text: Move filter libraries between databases with JSON bundles.
